definitions.explanation: Acceptable or sufficient for a purpose.

examples.english: I think a cheap hotel is good enough if we can stay there.

notes:
USAGE: {上等|じょうとう} describes high quality or grade. Can also be used to mean "good enough" or "acceptable."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {上等|じょうとう}な + noun (fine ~, high-quality ~)
- ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{上等|じょうとう}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (this is good enough)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上等|じょうとう} - first-class, fine quality
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧ - ordinary, average
- ⟦{下等|かとう}→下等：noentry⟧ - inferior, low-grade

SLANG: In rough speech, {上等|じょうとう}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧! can mean "Bring it on!" or "Fine by me!" (challenging tone).
